definition.fold_cut_points: training-only empirical tertiles within each expanding fold
definition.decision: within side and regime, choose FOLLOW or INVERT by higher mean paired TRAIN replay PnL; ties FOLLOW
definition.threshold_sensitivity: training-only 25/75 quantile diagnostic; cannot replace primary

expected_direction: Lower entry quote friction should preserve or improve FOLLOW-relative policy outcomes; sign is evaluated separately by side.
failure_criteria: fewer than 70% positive eligible folds for either side
one fold, source block, or session contributes over 50% of positive effect
insufficient support in either side or fewer than two source blocks/sessions
effect sign changes across 0/250/500 ms or magnitude sensitivity exceeds protocol bound
drawdown proxy worsens over the frozen 20% limit
quote tape, fold membership, or source hashes cannot be verified
selection_boundary: TRAIN walk-forward only; no Discovery Validation, prospective cohort, or FINAL_TEST access
hash_policy: SHA-256 sidecar is immutable after preregistration; amendments require a new hypothesis ID/version before any evaluation
